# Discovery structure templates — not an evidence repository

> **These files are blank structural templates only. This directory is not an authorized evidence repository, and completed copies MUST NOT be committed here.**

The templates provide optional headings for governed discovery work conducted in an approved external research system. Their presence does not establish that research has occurred, that evidence exists, or that any finding has been accepted.

## Prohibited content

Do not add completed records or participant data to this directory. In particular, no names, contact information, employer names, raw notes, transcripts, recordings, telemetry, consent records, procurement documents, or identifying quotations may be added.

Completed records remain in the approved external research system unless a privacy-handling record explicitly authorizes a repository path and permitted schema. That authorization must also define the applicable minimization, access, review, retention, deletion, and disclosure controls.

Creating these templates does **not** authorize creation of `docs/discovery/`. If a repository evidence area is subsequently authorized, its first commit MUST include the non-sensitive approval reference and a README defining the approved schema and controls, as required by the [discovery research plan](../../discovery-research-plan.md#recording-and-synthesis-rules-after-approval).

## Available blank templates

- [`interview-synthesis-template.md`](interview-synthesis-template.md) structures one privacy-governed interview synthesis.
- [`paired-round-summary-template.md`](paired-round-summary-template.md) structures a round-level review across provider and relying-party evidence.

Copy a template only into the approved external research system unless an explicit privacy-handling authorization permits another destination. Do not replace instructional placeholders with evidence in this directory.
